{{Quote|I'm sure she's picking up interesting information in her dealings with us. Too bad she can't be trusted.|Hume Tarl|<ref name="SWG:AED">{{GalaxiesAED}}</ref>}}
'''Dina Whisper''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] individual who worked as an informant for the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]] on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|Don't hurt me. I'll go quietly.|Dina Whisper|<ref name="SWG:AED" />}}
Sometime following [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]] started to suspect that Whisper was selling information about the Empire's operations to the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]]. [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[Hume Tarl/Legends|Hume Tarl]] enlisted the help of an Imperial agent to track Whisper down and arrest her. During questioning, Whisper revealed the location of a small [[Black market/Legends|black market]] outpost near [[Coronet City/Legends|Coronet]] where information and weapons were sold to the Rebel Alliance.

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:TemplateCommoner.png|250px|thumb|Every possible depictions of Dina Whisper]]
Dina Whisper was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]]. The game was shut down on [[December 15]], [[2011]]. Due to the nature of many older [[:w:c:swg:Quest|quests]] in ''Star Wars Galaxies'', the [[Species/Legends|species]] and appearance of Dina Whisper changed each time a player performed this quest. Therefore, it is impossible to verify the [[canon]]ical species of Whisper. However, the quest dialogue given by [[Hume Tarl/Legends|Tarl]] indicated that Dina Whisper was a [[Gender/Legends|female]].
